nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract, set in the constructor and read by owner()/onlyOwner.
ERC20 mapping of account balances, updated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance, written by _approve.
Total token supply, increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Token name string set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the ERC20 constructor.
ALPHA mapping of address=>bool anti-bot blacklist, toggled by BotBlacklist and read by _twitterAlpha.
ALPHA gate address; when transfers target it the sender must be blacklisted (anti-bot gate).
Internal view returning msg.sender; used as the caller identity everywhere in the contract.
Internal view returning msg.data; unused placeholder for meta-transaction support.
Sets the deployer obtained from _msgSender as the initial _owner.
Returns the current _owner address.
Access-control modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender().
ERC20 constructor storing name_ and symbol_ into _name and _symbol.
Returns the stored token name.
Returns the stored token symbol.
Returns the fixed decimals value 18.
Returns _totalSupply.
Returns the balance of the given account from _balances.
Public transfer; delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Returns the allowance of spender for owner from _allowances.
Public approve; delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Transfer using allowance; reads _allowances, performs a subtraction of the allowance and calls _approve.
Adds addedValue to the caller allowance via an unchecked-style addition before _approve.
Subtracts subtractedValue from the caller allowance after a require check, then calls _approve.
Internal core transfer: validates addresses, invokes the _twitterAlpha hook, adjusts _balances with subtraction and addition.
Internal mint: invokes the _twitterAlpha hook, increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal burn: invokes the _twitterAlpha hook, decreases account balance and total supply after a require.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
Empty virtual hook called before any transfer, mint or burn.
ALPHA constructor minting 1e9 tokens to a hard-coded address and blacklisting it.
onlyOwner function writing the anti-bot flag for an arbitrary address into _blacklisted.
Overridden mint enforcing a 1e9 * 1e18 supply cap via an addition before calling super._mint.
onlyOwner function that stores an arbitrary address into the _alphaToken trading gate.
Hook override: if the recipient equals _alphaToken it requires _blacklisted[from] to be true (anti-bot trading gate).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowances and transfers.
Balance subtraction senderBalance - amount performed in _transfer.
Balance subtraction accountBalance - amount performed in _burn.
Total supply decrement _totalSupply -= amount performed in _burn.
Allowance subtraction currentAllowance - amount performed in transferFrom.
Allowance addition _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance.
Allowance subtraction currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance.
Supply cap computation ERC20.totalSupply() + amount compared against 1e9 * 1e18.
Total supply increment _totalSupply += amount performed in ERC20._mint.
Recipient balance increment _balances[recipient] += amount performed in _transfer.
Ownership gate evaluation owner() == _msgSender() that protects privileged functions.
Local variable holding the deployer address returned by _msgSender in the Ownable constructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender as the caller identity.
onlyOwner compares owner() with the caller supplied by _msgSender.
transfer uses the caller as the source account.
approve uses the caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom reads the caller allowance entry.
increaseAllowance uses the caller allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance uses the caller allowance entry.
The caller becomes the sender of the internal transfer when transfer is used.
The constructor writes the deployer address into _owner.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
Constructor stores name_ into _name.
Constructor stores symbol_ into _symbol.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads _balances.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads the allowance of sender for the caller.
increaseAllowance reads the existing allowance before adding.
decreaseAllowance reads the existing allowance before subtracting.
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances.
_transfer reads the sender balance from _balances.
_transfer writes the adjusted balances back into _balances.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
The capped mint override reads totalSupply() for the cap comparison.
The ALPHA hook reads _blacklisted[from] to allow or block the transfer.
The ALPHA hook compares the recipient against the _alphaToken gate address.
BotBlacklist writes the anti-bot flag into _blacklisted.
RenounceOwnership writes an arbitrary address into the _alphaToken trading gate.
The ALPHA constructor blacklists the initial hard-coded holder.
The Ownable constructor calls _msgSender to obtain the deployer.
The onlyOwner modifier evaluates the ownership check operation.
BotBlacklist is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
RenounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer delegates the state changes to _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
ALPHA._mint calls super._mint after the cap check.
The ALPHA constructor mints the initial supply through the capped override.
_transfer performs the sender balance subtraction.
_burn performs the account balance subtraction.
_burn performs the total supply decrement.
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction.
increaseAllowance performs the allowance addition.
decreaseAllowance performs the allowance subtraction.
ALPHA._mint performs the cap-check addition.
ERC20._mint performs the total supply increment.
_transfer performs the recipient balance increment.
_transfer invokes the overridable _twitterAlpha hook before changing balances.
_mint invokes the overridable _twitterAlpha hook before minting.
_burn invokes the overridable _twitterAlpha hook before burning.
The local msgSender feeds the _owner assignment in the constructor.
name_ is consumed by the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is consumed by the ERC20 constructor.

recipient indexes _balances inside _transfer.

account is credited inside ERC20._mint.
amount is added to the supply and balance in ERC20._mint.
account is debited inside _burn.
amount is subtracted from the balance and supply in _burn.

owner indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
spender indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.

amount takes part in the cap check and the minted value.

to is compared against _alphaToken in the hook.
amount is received by the hook though unused in the gate logic.
